title: Lace Garden Shawl
description: An heirloom-quality triangular shawl worked in fine lace weight yarn. The garden motif features flowing leaf and blossom repeats that build into a stunning border. Best suited for experienced knitters comfortable with lace charts, yarn-overs, and decreases.
yarnRequirements: 350–400g lace weight or fingering weight yarn (approx. 1400–1600m). Shown in sage green.
gauge: 24 sts × 32 rows = 10 cm in stocking stitch (blocked). Gauge is less critical for shawls — focus on drape.

instructions.title: Garter Tab Cast On
instructions.body: Cast on 3 sts. Work in garter stitch (knit every row) for 8 rows. Do not turn after the last row. Pick up 4 sts along the left edge, then pick up 3 sts from the cast-on edge (10 sts total). This forms the initial spine of the shawl.

instructions.title: Body Setup
instructions.body: Setup row (WS): K3, pm, p1, pm, p2, pm, p1, pm, k3. Right side rows: K3, sm, yo, k to marker, yo, sm, k1, sm, yo, k to last marker, yo, sm, k3. Wrong side rows: K3, p to last 3 sts, k3. Repeat these 2 rows, increasing 4 sts every RS row, until you have 130 sts.

instructions.title: Lace Body Sections
instructions.body: Begin working the Garden Lace repeat (Chart A, 16-row repeat) on the two main sections of the shawl, maintaining the garter border and spine increases. Work Chart A twice (32 rows). The chart uses yo, k2tog, ssk, and sl1-k2tog-psso for the leaf shapes.

instructions.title: Border
instructions.body: Work the Blossom Border (Chart B, 24 rows). This border is deeper and more ornate — work carefully and place additional markers to track pattern sections. The border does not continue the spine increases; instead it fans outward from the existing stitches.

instructions.title: Cast Off & Blocking
instructions.body: Cast off loosely using a stretchy bind off (e.g. k2, *slip both sts back to left needle, k2tog through back loop, k1; repeat). Blocking is essential: soak in cool water for 20 minutes, squeeze gently, and pin to measurements on blocking mats. Leave to dry completely (12–24 hours). The lace will open dramatically on blocking.

reviews.author: eleanor_f
reviews.body: A genuine masterpiece of a pattern. Took me nearly 3 weeks but the result is breathtaking. Blocked out perfectly.

reviews.author: PattiKnits
reviews.body: Beutiful pattern but I found a couple of errors in Chart B that had me confused for a good hour or so. The designer did respond quickly when I messaged them though, so good customer service at least!

reviews.author: LaceWithLouise
reviews.body: This is my magnum opus. Blocked and framed it 😂 absolutely gorgeous. If you're thinking about it, just buy it.

reviews.author: Helen_W
reviews.body: Very challenging but mostly clear instructions. I think there might be a small error on Chart B row 14 - had to wing it a bit there. End result is stunning though.

reviews.author: croft_maker
reviews.body: Incredible pattern. If you're an advanced knitter this is a must have. The garden motif blocks out to something really speical.

reviews.author: anna_threads
reviews.body: I bought this expecting advanced but manageable — it's genuinely hard. Had to frog twice. The end result is beautiful but please be prepaired for a real challenge before purchasing.
